title: PACE
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail

music.tags: driving percussion, ostinato strings, insistent low brass, forward motion, instrumental

beats.prompt: A single running shoe on wet tarmac at dawn, close-up, cold blue light, water beading on the surface
beats.motion: A drop of water runs off the sole.
beats.caption: Anyone can sell you mile one

line.text: The first mile is easy. Anyone can sell you the first mile.

beats.sfx: a shoe set down on wet ground

beats.prompt: A runner's legs mid-stride on an empty city street at dawn, motion blur, cinematic, low angle
beats.motion: The legs drive forward hard. Spray kicks up from the road.
beats.caption: Built for mile five

line.text: PACE is built for the fifth. Where the cushioning usually gives up.

beats.prompt: A close-up of a shoe sole showing dense foam structure, studio light, clean product photography
beats.motion: Light travels slowly across the sole.
beats.caption: Holds its shape when you are tired

line.text: A denser midsole that holds its shape when you are tired and sloppy.

beats.prompt: A runner stopping at the top of a hill at sunrise, seen from behind, wide shot, warm light breaking
beats.motion: The runner's chest rises and falls. Light brightens across the hill.
beats.caption: PACE - the mile after you wanted to stop

line.text: PACE. The mile that counts is the one after you wanted to stop.
